_: How many staves the page prints in a system, read off the crop by a person.
The check compares a reference against a parse, and when the two disagree
about the staves it has no third party to ask -- so it says they differ and
stops. That is not enough: on this repertoire the disagreement has been the
reference's fault as often as homr's, and telling them apart takes one look
at the printed band. Every entry here is one such look, written down so the
next reader inherits it instead of taking it again.
A count, because that is the part a person can be sure of at a glance and
the part every note is keyed on. Not which voice is on which row -- that
needs the words and the range, and a half-remembered answer is worse than
none. `why` says what was seen, so the claim can be checked against the
crop the report already puts at the top of every case page.
Absent means unknown, which is most cases. Nothing is inferred and nothing
is filled in from a parse: a number here is a person's reading or it is not
